sections.title: Asking and answering
sections.content: Ask about time with *Mikor jó neked?* (When is it good for you?) Answer with the time first or the pronoun first: *Nekem szombaton jó.* or *Szombaton jó nekem.* Say 'not' with *nem* before *jó*: *Nekem nem jó este.* Join two views with *de*: *Nekem nem jó, de neki jó.* To agree, say *Jó ötlet!* New words: *ötlet* (idea), *később* (later) and *hétvégén* (at the weekend).

sections.content: Putting the pronoun first stresses it: *Nekem jó, de neki nem.* (It suits me, but not her.)
